name: workflow
subject: the practice cratylus ships for delegating work by intent and taking back results that realize a conceptual model, keeping the semantic gap between settled meaning and built work closed by construction, never by a proxy, a green suite or an agent's own account, nor by agents remembering
relation: conforms to cratylic context design; practised on a user's own bounded contexts, never modelling them; its roles are agents composed in the agents context
reason: The workflow no longer defines semantic gap, an established term owned by cratylic context design; what its old concept said, that the practice keeps the gap closed by construction, is the practice's subject. The workflow conforms to the pattern like every other context.
